items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency hotfix for a critical zero-day vulnerability, actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. This flaw, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler' by Sansec, has a CVSS score of 10.0 and affects versions 2.4.4 through 2.4.9.

items.title: CosmicSting: Critical Vulnerability Leading to Mass Exploitation
items.summary: Sansec reported that CosmicSting, also known as CVE-2024-34102, is a severe vulnerability actively exploited, with stores being compromised at a high rate. This bug is considered the worst to affect Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Magento vendor Fishpig hacked, backdoors added
items.summary: Sansec discovered that Fishpig, a vendor of popular Magento-Wordpress integrations, was hacked, resulting in malware injection into their software and compromise of their servers. This supply chain attack poses a significant risk to users of Fishpig's integrations.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover and other vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released security updates addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover flaw with a CVSS score of 9.1. This vulnerability allows attackers to switch customer sessions and access private data without authentication.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: Included in APSB26-92, this high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could enable a security-feature bypass. This vulnerability requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for numerous Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: Sansec identified an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension, allowing attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension.
